description: Implementation of an email sender that composes and sends HTML emails with attachments and templates using JavaMail and FreeMarker.

classes.name: HtmlEmailSenderImpl
classes.description: Implements email sending with template processing, supporting HTML and plain text parts, with optional email configuration.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Builds and sends an email message using provided email data, processing templates for email content.

methods.name: getFreemarkerMailConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the FreeMarker configuration used for email templates.

methods.name: setFreemarkerMailConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the FreeMarker configuration for email templates.

methods.name: getMailSender
methods.description: Returns the JavaMailSender instance used to send emails.

methods.name: setMailSender
methods.description: Sets the JavaMailSender instance used to send emails.

methods.name: getEmailConfig
methods.description: Returns the email configuration (server, port, credentials).
